MIF F/S table columns = F/S Training Sections (sorties, means of training)

edge_kinds.sequence: arrow drawn in the Training Flow Chart inside the same column / phase
edge_kinds.prereq: arrow drawn in the Training Flow Chart crossing columns (ground → F/S, ground → A/C, F/S → A/C, category → category)
edge_kinds.implied: ordering that follows from the position of the boxes / from the PART II-III programme, with no arrow drawn

legend.symbols_verbatim: A/C SORTIE / GROUND TRAINING (CBTS/LESSONS) / F/S TRAINING. * Potential SOLO flights are depicted with a green frame. ** Evaluation flights are depicted with orange color. *** Night flights are depicted with red color.
notes: No node carries kind='solo': the syllabus marks SOLO with a green frame on individual sorties inside a Training Section, so SOLO is expressed with solo_allowed / solo_required / sorties_solo / solo_candidate_sorties.
solo_required=true only where SOLO is structural to the Section (C4790-91 = checkride for SOLO + 1st SOLO). §9.c nevertheless makes every SOLO sortie mandatory — see totals.minimum_hours_verbatim.
Ground exams live in two places: 8 as nodes with kind=='ground_exam', the other 6 as entries of the 'exams' array on their theory node. Read both to get the syllabus' full set of 14.

duration_verbatim = literal text from the single cited page, or null. duration_summary = editorially composed multi-row text, present only on the 9 theory nodes whose figures span several table rows / pages. Quote duration_verbatim, never duration_summary.

name on the sim / flight / checkride nodes is the MISSION line printed in the PART IV (or PART III) Training Section header. Where two Sections print the identical MISSION they carry the identical name (F4401-04 and F4501-03); mission_verbatim / objective_verbatim are recorded on those two nodes.

totals.ground_training_verbatim: SPs shall attend Ground Training program, which comprises 524 (282 for the foreign SPs) training periods.
totals.ground_training_min_duration_verbatim: In advance, minimum duration for ground training is twenty five (25) working days (including 10 days of WSGES training).
totals.flight_training_min_duration_verbatim: The duration of flight training is at least 78 flying days.

source.ref: PART III, §13.a GENERAL PROGRAM
PART IV, §14.a GENERAL PROGRAM

totals.minimum_hours_verbatim: No SP shall finish the Training Phase, having flown less than 77,0 DUAL flight hours and less than 6,0 SOLO flight hours. All the SOLO sorties are mandatory to be executed.
totals.final_evaluations_verbatim: The last sortie of each Category of Training Exercises (Contact – Instruments – Formation and Navigation) stands as an evaluation and constitutes the final examination for these categories. The sorties in question are: C5490, I4890, F4690 and Ν4690.
totals.ground_gate_verbatim: No SP shall begin training in a Training Section or Exercise if he/she has not previously attended and successfully been evaluated upon the objects of ground training, as they appear in the Training Flow Chart.

flags: I4101-02 sorties/hours: the PART IV header (PDF 193) prints 'SORTIES/HOURS TOTAL: 3 / 3.9', but the MIF table, the Training Flow Chart (only I4101 and I4102 boxes) and the PART IV general programme (INSTRUMENT 14 sorties / 18,4 h) all give 2 sorties. Summing the other Instrument sections gives 12 sorties / 15,8 h, so the missing block must be 2 / 2,6. sorties_dual=2 was kept (3 sources agree); hours_total was left null instead of choosing a figure the syllabus never prints.

C 2501 / C 2502 are drawn twice in the Flow Chart: on the CONTACT page (C 2502 → C 4602) and again on the FORMATION page (C 2502 → F 4303). The MIF gives section C2501-03 only 3 sorties, so the second depiction is a cross-reference, not extra sorties. Both edges are kept, marked in their notes.

PART II text (PDF 105) states '524 (282 for the foreign SPs) training periods', while the foreign-SP table (PDF 107) totals 279. The Greek total of 524 reconciles exactly with the node periods; the foreign figure is recorded as printed in totals.ground_training_periods_foreign_sps = 279 with the 282 discrepancy left unresolved.

Lesson-code differences between the Flow Chart boxes and the PART II table: 'OP 101-115' vs 'OP 101-15', 'FF 101-108' vs 'FF 101-107', 'CO 106-108' vs 'CO 106-107', 'SOPs 101-104' vs 'SOP 101-104', 'IPR PL2' vs 'OPR PL2', 'NA 101-103' vs 'NA 101-3'. Flow-Chart labels were used for node labels; PART II codes are quoted in duration_verbatim.

Ground academics are grouped: 41 ground boxes of the Flow Chart are condensed into 12 theory nodes; only the 8 exams that gate an F/S or A/C sortie (CO 190, JP 190, IN 190, IN 290, FO 190, TACFOR 590, NA 190, LNAV 790) are kept as separate ground_exam nodes. The other 6 exams (FF 190, PT 190, AE 190, JX 190, JX 191, NA 191) gate only further ground lessons and stay inside their theory node, where they are listed in that node's 'exams' array (code / name / periods / periods_foreign / gates); every gate was verified against the Training Flow Chart: FF 190 → CO 101-105, PT 190 → BB 101-102, AE 190 → CR 201-202*, JX 190-191 → JP 190*, NA 191 → GPS.

FULL EXAM SET = the 8 nodes with kind=='ground_exam' PLUS the 'exams' entries of GT-FLYPRIN (FF 190, PT 190), GT-AERO-CRM (AE 190), GT-METEO-BA (JX 190, JX 191) and GT-IFRNAV-GPS (NA 191) = the 14 exams the syllabus defines. Filtering on kind=='ground_exam' alone returns 8 and under-counts.

duration_verbatim vs duration_summary: duration_verbatim holds literal text from the ONE cited page — all 53 sim/flight nodes, the 8 ground_exam nodes and the 3 single-row theory nodes (GT-WSGES, GT-CO110, GT-CO109); ground rows are quoted as 'group heading: row | code | periods'. The 9 theory nodes that condense several table rows — some spanning PDF 105-106, two splicing in the PDF-109 supplementary lessons under a '[suppl.]' marker — carry duration_verbatim=null and hold the composed text in duration_summary. No figure was dropped in the split; duration_summary must not be quoted as source text.

periods_foreign holds the foreign-SP training periods from the separate PART II §11.b(6) table (PDF 107; JP 190 from §11.c(1)(c), PDF 109). It is present on every ground_exam node and on every entry of the theory nodes' 'exams' arrays. These counts were previously spliced into the duration_verbatim of CO 190 / IN 190 / IN 290 as '(foreign SPs: 1)'. JX 191 has no foreign row (that table has no 'Meteorology II' section) → null. Theory nodes carry no periods_foreign: their totals would have to be summed across rows, which the syllabus does not print — the printed foreign total is in totals.ground_training_periods_foreign_sps.

Node count 73 exceeds the 45-65 guidance: the 34 T-6A Training Sections plus the 19 F/S Training Sections (both required as individual nodes) already occupy 53, and the ground side cannot go below 20 nodes without dropping the exam gates. Merging the small gate nodes into their category theory blocks was considered and rejected: folding GT-CO109 into GT-INSTR turns the graph from a DAG into one containing 5 directed cycles (GT-INSTR → IN 190 → I 3101-02 → … → I 4501-02 → GT-INSTR), because the Flow Chart feeds CO 109 from I 4501. GT-CO110 and GT-WSGES could be merged without creating a cycle, but each is drawn as its own box / programme line, so all three are kept.

hours_per_sortie is populated only where a Section contains a single sortie (there the printed total IS the per-sortie figure). For multi-sortie Sections the syllabus prints only the Section total, so hours_per_sortie is null — no per-sortie value was computed.

The A/C Systems (WSGES) block and the General Briefing block (125 periods) are in the PART II programme but have no box in the Training Flow Chart. GT-GENBRIEF therefore has no edges (continuous briefings throughout the phase).

solo_required=true only on C4790-91 (the Section IS 'Contact checkride for SOLO (C4790) and 1st SOLO (C4791)'). §9.c ('All the SOLO sorties are mandatory to be executed') makes every SOLO mandatory in practice — recorded in totals.minimum_hours_verbatim, not duplicated per node.
Failure / regression paths (FCJ, re-checks, elimination per §9.e and BD 3-1/HATC) are deliberately NOT modelled, per scope.
